title: Roofing Estimate Template: Fill In, Download PDF, Word, Excel
description: Write a roofing estimate in your browser: squares, tear-off, flashing, decking allowance, deposit. No sign-up. US price ranges and insurance rules, with sources.
lede_html: Enter the roof in this form and get an estimate as a PDF, Word or Excel file. No account. The sample is a 24-square shingle replacement. Replace it with your measurements.

sample.scope: Tear off 1 layer, install underlayment, drip edge, architectural shingles on 24 squares. Replace pipe boots. Clean up with magnet sweep.
sample.exclusions: Rotten decking beyond the allowance, gutters, skylights, attic ventilation changes.
sample.terms: Decking is priced per sheet after tear-off. Your insurance deductible is yours to pay.

items.d: Ice and water shield at valleys

must_show.heading: What a roofing estimate should say
must_show.intro_html: A roofing estimate is mostly measurements. Give the roof size in squares, the layers to remove, the materials by name, and how you will price the decking that you cannot see yet.
must_show.why_label: Why it matters on a roof
rows: One square is 100 sq ft. The customer can compare bids on the same size.
Each added layer costs more to remove and dispose of.
A plain word such as "shingles" invites disputes.
The damage is unknown until tear-off, so agree on a unit price now.
Keep it apart from the maker warranty on the material.
Say that the owner pays the deductible. Florida prohibits offers to waive one.

example.heading: Filled example: leak and flashing repair
example.intro_html: A smaller job on another home, with sample prices.

line_items.heading: Roofing line items and typical prices
line_items.intro_html: Tap Add to put a line on the form. The range comes from the source in the same row. The price that the button adds is a sample inside that range, not a price recommendation.
line_items.after_html: For scale: US roofers had a median wage of $55,440 per year in May 2025 (BLS).

rules.heading: Rules to check before you send a roofing estimate

items.title: Florida: no waived deductible
items.html: Florida Statutes 489.147 lists as prohibited an offer to a residential owner of a rebate, gift, cash or waiver of an insurance deductible for allowing a roof inspection or making a claim.

items.title: California: down payment
items.html: The cap on a home improvement job is the lesser of $1,000 or 10 percent, except for blanket-bond licensees, so a large roof deposit may be far below 10 percent.

items.title: Sales at the customer home
items.html: After a sale at the home, a buyer may cancel until midnight of the third business day, under the FTC Cooling-Off Rule. The rule has exceptions, such as a repair visit that the buyer asked for. Add the notice when you sign after a door-knock.

faq.q: Should I show insurance estimate amounts on my estimate?
faq.a: Show your own price for your own scope. If the customer shares the adjuster paperwork, answer it in a separate document and do not offer to absorb the deductible.

faq.q: How do I price decking that I cannot see?
faq.a: Give a unit price per sheet or per square foot and an allowance. Bill what you replace after tear-off, and take a photo of each sheet.

faq.q: Do I measure in squares or square feet?
faq.a: Use what your crew and supplier use, and say which unit. The form has a unit field for each line.

faq.q: How long should a roofing estimate be valid?
faq.a: Use a short period when shingle prices move. The sample uses 14 days, and you can change it in the form.
